nondeterministic.close-workspace: two workspaces: session.snapshot orders screens by workspace id (workspace_registry resource_store/topology_load.rs load_screens, ORDER BY workspace_id), and ids are random until p15-oracle-185 seeds them, so the canonical labels swap in about half the runs; the daemon-ops suite's two-workspace cases show the same
nondeterministic.new-pane-right: #26031 cmux-tui: the frontend selects a surface it created when the creation's completion arrives, and only if its tree already holds the surface (app/session_apply.rs select_completed_surface, tab_locations); when the remote tree refresh lands after the completion, the old pane or screen stays selected (1 to 3 runs in 20 on the VM). The daemon facet is the same; the screen differs
